items.verseEn: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

items.verse: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍۢ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ يَعْدِلُونَ
items.verseEn: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].

items.verse: ۞ إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۚ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّـٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍۢ
items.verseEn: To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."

items.verse: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمُ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا وَٱزَّيَّنَتْ وَظَنَّ أَهْلُهَآ أَنَّهُمْ قَـٰدِرُونَ عَلَيْهَآ أَتَىٰهَآ أَمْرُنَا لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًۭا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا حَصِيدًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ تَغْنَ بِٱلْأَمْسِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
items.verseEn: The example of [this] worldly life is but like rain which We have sent down from the sky that the plants of the earth absorb - [those] from which men and livestock eat - until, when the earth has taken on its adornment and is beautified and its people suppose that they have capability over it, there comes to it Our command by night or by day, and We make it as a harvest, as if it had not flourished yesterday. Thus do We explain in detail the signs for a people who give thought.

categories.name: أَنْوَاعُ الْمُسْتَوْطَنَاتِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Types of human settlements in the Quran

items.verse: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَـٰتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَآئِلُونَ
items.verseEn: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.

items.verse: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌۭ مِّنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱلْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَٱخْرُجْ إِنِّى لَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّـٰصِحِينَ
items.verseEn: And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, "O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors."

items.verse: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: [Say, O Muḥammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh].

items.verse: وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ ۖ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
items.verseEn: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ ثَمُودَ فِي سُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ
categories.nameEn: Key terms from the story of Thamud in Surah Al-Qamar

items.verse: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
items.verseEn: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

items.verse: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
items.verseEn: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

items.verse: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
items.verseEn: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

categories.name: كَلِمَاتُ الطَّرِيقَيْنِ فِي سُورَةِ الْبَلَدِ
categories.nameEn: Vocabulary of the two paths in Surah Al-Balad

items.verseEn: And have shown him the two ways?
Those are the companions of the right.

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
items.verseEn: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
Over them will be fire closed in.

harf.hint: How Allah's guidance was sent down to the Prophet ﷺ gradually, piece by piece
harf.arabicVerse: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
harf.verse: 76:23 - Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

deduction.title: The Garden That Vanished Overnight
deduction.intro: Picture a lush garden, heavy with ripening fruit and surrounded by towering trees. Those who tended it thought themselves clever, planning their harvest in the quiet hours before dawn, away from the eyes of those in need. But the One who never sleeps had other plans for their hidden bounty. Can you guess who stands behind this cautionary tale from the Quran?
clues: We once possessed a garden so lush and abundant that it became the envy of all who passed by.
In our planning, we whispered to one another early in the morning, declaring that no needy soul would be allowed to enter that day.
We were people of wealth, and our hearts had grown blind to the rights of the poor around us.
When the dawn of our intended harvest arrived, we approached our garden only to find it transformed into a blackened ruin overnight.
A devastating decree swept through, leaving nothing but ashes where clusters of ripe fruit had once hung.
Our tale is a stern warning recorded in the Quran, where we are known as the owners of the garden who withheld charity from the needy.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Owners of the Garden
The People of the Cave
The Disciples of Isa
The Companions of the Wood
The Guests of Ibrahim

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Secretly harvesting fruit and barring the poor
Sleeping for centuries inside a cave
Refusing to produce a she-camel from stone
Worshipping a golden calf at Mount Sinai
Building a great ark to escape a flood
trial.answer: Secretly harvesting fruit and barring the poor

location.label: Key Element
options: A walled garden filled with palms and vines
A dark cavern deep in the mountains
A city overtaken by a divine hurricane
A sacred valley near the House of Allah
The banks of a flowing river
location.answer: A walled garden filled with palms and vines

outcome.label: Outcome
options: The garden was consumed by a scorching decree from heaven
They slept peacefully for 309 lunar years
They were crushed by a rain of stones
They drowned beneath the waves of a great flood
They were scattered by a blast of cold, raging wind
outcome.answer: The garden was consumed by a scorching decree from heaven

deduction.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
deduction.verse: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. (68:33)

scramble.hint: This verse reassures believers that hearts find true peace and tranquility through the remembrance (dhikr) of Allah.
scramble.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
scramble.verseEn: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
